# Review, pass 1 — kebra-nagast-ch94 (ch. 94)

Checked: every note label against the form, original to `l` word by word, `l` against `i`, remembered English in `i`, the house renderings in known-forms.json and the published parts (ch. 17–20, 25, 46–48, 57–59, 83–86). `t` joined still equals the packet's Geʿez (verified by script). Edits made by script. Units are numbered from 0.

Totals: 0 major, 8 moderate, 12 minor; 5 findings refused.

## Changes

| Unit | Field | Severity | What was wrong | What was done |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | l, i, n | moderate | እምህገረ ምስፍና is "from the city of"; `i` made it "reached Məsfəna", contradicting `l` and the grammar (እም- is "from"). `l` also left ህገረ untranslated against ሀገረ "city-of" in unit 1. | `l` "from-city-of ምስፍና"; `i` "arrived from the city of Məsfəna"; note states እም- is "from" and keeps the ህገረ slip remark. |
| 2, 3, 5, 6 | l, n | moderate | ተዐየኑ: the house entry is "were seen / met face to face (?)"; `l` had "came-to" (unhedged in 3, 5), i.e. a sense that is not the house word. | `l` now "met(?)" in all four places; note says the hedge applies wherever it recurs. `i` "came to / came upon" kept, as it is the context reading. |
| 3 | l | moderate | `l` "was-ጋእዘ(?)" invents a verb "was" that is not in the Geʿez. | `l` "ጋእዘ(?) in-her(?) with-them from-first". |

| 11 | l, i, n | moderate | ፈቃዲ: the note called it a slip and `l` gave "will-my(?)", against the published entry "his will (-ዲ for -ሁ, Bezold's spelling, as in ወልዲ)". | `l` "will-his"; `i` loses the "(?)"; note rewritten to the house reading. |

## Refused findings

1. Unit 1, ሐቢቶሙ "tent (?)" in `l` and `i`: unsupported, but already hedged with (?) in all three fields and flagged as a guess; no better reading can be had without Dillmann. Left.
2. Unit 1, the note's claim that the march "re-enacts" Sinai: interpretation, but marked as the text's own comparison (ከመ አሜሃ በደብረ ሲና). Left.
3. Unit 3, ጋእዘ ባ: could not be improved; the unit is already honest that it is unreadable. Left as hedged.
4. Unit 10, ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር "the Ark of God’s law": the Geʿez is "of his law, of God"; the `i` is a fair English rendering of the anticipating pattern already described in ch. 25. Left.
5. Unit 1's length (64 words, no ፤ inside): the note already says so and the source has no cut point; the checks (word count, no ። ፤ ፨ inside) agree. Left.

## Glossary

No `gloss.json` yet; this was pass 1 on `units.json` only. For the glosser and pass 2: ዘነበ must be ዘነብ "tail" (construct); ባ is በ + -ኣ; ዘይትለአክ is ለአከ tä-stem; ድማትዮስ stays Dəmatyos; ዘይመውኦ is from ሞዐ; ሰረገላ is "cart"; ተዐየኑ stays "(?)".

## Refused

1. Gloss ሐቢቶሙ "tent, dwelling (?)": unidentified, not in any published part, already hedged in gloss and all three fields of unit 1. Left.
2. Gloss ወፀብአ "and he fought · or ወ- + ፀብእ 'and war' (?)": the second reading is weak but harmless and hedged. Left.
3. Gloss ወተኃለፉ lemma ተኃለፈ (tä-stem of ኀለፈ): no published form; house practice (ተኤዘዘ, ተለአከ) takes the tä-stem as lemma. Left. Also unit 12 `i` "he did his will (?)" and unit 1's length: pass-1 refusals stand.

## For the lemma-consistency list (published parts, not touched)

ይመውእ in ch. 13–16 (and ወትመውኦሙ ch. 21–22, ትማእ ch. 69) is lemma መውአ, while ch. 88 and now ch. 94 use ሞዐ; one lemma should be chosen across the work.
